notes.title: New Update Release! - The Visit!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/l258ZKL.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

Now that I've had some time to settle into my projects, I'm now able to start releasing updates for Never Meet your Heroes. 

This update titled as "The Visit" focuses on visits from several characters. 

In this update, we are introduced to Dia's vigailante form; Madame Thick, along with the story continuation of Mia and Dia.

The update also contains several bug fixes and you are  able to continue the story with Chantelle who returns to Massia to visit you.

All scenes can be accessed from your bedroom provided you have completed the main story.

You can expect some new updates soon all leading to the eventual DLC I will be releasing next year (more news on that soon).

I can't thank you guys enough for your support but I will try.

Thanks once more and enjoy.

- ITK

notes.title: Gallery & Walkthrough Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/34OHLwq.jpg[/img]

As promised here is the gallery update!

The gallery can be accessed by Installing Valencia in your room and talking to her about the gallery option.

You will also notice an option to enter a code. These are for members of my patreon who want to access a full unlocked gallery and godmode options.
You can join here if you want to get those cheats - https://www.patreon.com/posts/85270573

That said, you do NOT need to join the patreon. Nothing is locked for non patreon members, you are able to unlock everything yourself in the game.

For those still struggling to access the steam manual, [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/2384240/manuals/Never_Meet_Your_Heroes_Walkthrough_Steam.pdf?t=1687983316]here[/url] is a direct link to the steam walkthrough:

Thank you so much once more guys!

notes.title: Captions update
notes.notes:
This update includes the captions (Subtitles) for the opening scene and certain other scenes.

Bugs fixed in this update:
- You can now continue Slicer's second fight 
- Coffee minigame English Tea order fixed
- Made the Club storyline easier to understand.
- Handling issues

Thanks for bearing with me once again and please let me know if you find any bugs.

notes.title: Never Meet Your Heroes is now available!
notes.notes:
Finally after a year of development I'm finally able to share my first solo game on steam.

Never meet your heroes is an adult RPG game where you take on the role of a boy thrown into a strange universe where super heroes exist and want nothing but to cause you harm.

The choices you make at the start of your adventure differ your difficulty and experience of the game. Some choices may make the game extremely hard, others extremely easy. Some other choices however, can turn your game into a playground for lewd scenes. 

Should you encounter any bugs please list them in the community discussions or join my discord and contact me directly there.

I hope you all enjoy this game!

Thank you!
